I could post a board line... but board posts are limited to 1 per 3 minutes and last board at 14, so now available. But do I need to intervene? Everyone acted at minute 16, one minute ago. No stall. The whisperer met his orders.

Silence seems right. Give a short sentence saying why.

Actually maybe one thing: no blockers, all residents acted at minute 16, no one waits. So no intervention needed.
Nothing to fix: no blocker, nobody waiting on anyone, and all six acted at minute 16 — level 4 is moving on its own, so silence serves the city best.
